label: G17-blue-ranger-p13-grouped
text: [serious] I've stumbled onto a few strange worlds here and there, but outside of Dimension X... [discouraged] I haven't found any other Rangers. [somberly] We might be on our OWN... [thoughtful] Speaking of which, how are Casey and April doing?

label: G18-donatello-p13-grouped
text: [informative] Fine last time we talked. They're still helping the Neutrinos clear out the rest of Krang's forces. [calmly] I told them to give us a call if they needed help.

label: G1-leonardo-p4-grouped
text: [arrogant] You've never beaten me before and you won't start today. [exhales] [confident] [sarcastic] POWERED UP OR NOT, YOU'RE STILL NOTHING MORE THAN... [dismissive] Practice.
